sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेता नतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥ १४-२१॥
iast:
arjuna uvāca
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetā natīto bhavati prabho
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃ strīnguṇānativartate 14-21
translation: Arjuna said: What are the marks of him who has crossed over the three GUNAS, O Lord? What is his conduct, and how does he go beyond these three GUNAS?
